verdict.rationale: Grok's overview lists Grok Bot, which lets you 'hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer.' That is a direct first-party claim of task delegation to an agent, but it is a single thin line with no detail on how it works. The multi-agent research doc describes multi-step work happening 'in real time', not background execution handed back later, so it adds little. Missing for 10: documentation of background or asynchronous execution, a review or hand-back workflow for results, task status or notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration of Grok Bot.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Grok Bot — hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer.
Realtime Multi-agent Research enables Grok to orchestrate multiple AI agents that work together in real time to perform deep, multi-step research tasks.
